waypoints.name: Stuart Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Leavenworth, follow Icicle Road about 8.4 miles to FR 7601, then FR 7601 another 3.7 miles to the Stuart Lake Trailhead at 3,400 ft. In spring, before that road opens, you are adding roughly four miles of Eightmile Road each way on foot or ski, and that is the single biggest variable in the day — check whether the road is open before you commit to a plan. Parties usually car-camp near the trailhead and start early to catch the couloir on firm snow.

waypoints.name: Colchuck Lake
waypoints.directions: From the trailhead, follow the Stuart Lake Trail along Mountaineer Creek about 2.5 miles to the signed junction and take the Colchuck Lake Trail, which crosses the creek and switchbacks up to Colchuck Lake at about 5,570 ft. When the lake is frozen, parties often cross it directly.

waypoints.name: Colchuck Peak summit
waypoints.directions: Go around to the far, south side of the lake, climb up onto the lateral moraine and follow its crest right toward the glacier. The couloir is the first major gully the moraine leads into; cross or skirt the moat, climb about 2,000 ft of snow to the notch at its top, and continue to the summit.
